title: Tip Tax Set-Aside Coverage
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), cashback events (`cashback:event`), price tracker alerts (`pricetrack:alert`), and tip logs (`tiplog:shift`).
app: Micro-finance telemetry for latte-factor spending, cashback apps, price tracking, and tip logging sent to Splunk HEC via finance exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tiplog:shift
| search recommended_set_aside=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(set_aside_amount) as set_aside_amount sum(recommended_set_aside) as recommended_set_aside by _time job_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks tip tax set-aside coverage over time and breaks it out by job.
value: Coverage against a recommended set-aside helps keep cash tips from becoming a tax surprise later.
implementation: Send tip tax set-aside coverage events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of tip tax set-aside coverage by job.
grandmaExplanation: It turns how tip tax set-aside coverage changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
